rationale: A's desktop preloader sits at "000%" on a near-empty dark screen through every entrance frame (to ~5.7 s) and is still covering the page in the post-entrance top frame, so its hero is never seen on desktop and the phone's first viewport is likewise still the loader; B's red hero resolves cleanly by 1.3 s with a line-by-line headline reveal and a town-hall elevation that draws itself in. Below the fold A is the lusher site (illustrated project scenes in a horizontal gallery, a pinned site-plan drawing that builds stage by stage, wood-grain NORR footer), but B answers with an equally brief-specific drawing-sheet system: plate captions, section/elevation plates, a pinned isometric assembly that goes from frame to clad building, and a title-block footer, all consistently aligned on desktop and mobile. B's hover states are crisp inversions and underlines, whereas A's custom cursor ring obscures labels and the Enquire pill is captured as a blank cream fill with no visible text.
